# Performance Evidence

Status: passed on 2026-08-21.

## Environment

- Python 3.13.14, Django 5.2.17, PostgreSQL 16.11.
- Windows; Intel Core Ultra 7 155H, 16 cores / 22 logical processors, 63.5 GB RAM.
- Disposable local PostgreSQL cluster on loopback and local temporary storage; no public network latency.
- Django development settings with debug logging behavior. Repeat this result if production capacity or logging is materially lower or more expensive.
- Dataset: 100 initial tracks and 50 modules per track.

Command:

```powershell
$env:RUN_CATALOG_BENCHMARK = "1"
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py test tests.catalog.benchmark_admin --settings=kronolearn.settings.development -v 1
```

## Result

- Warm-ups excluded: 20.
- Measured requests: 200 (50 create, 50 edit, 50 reorder, 50 state).
- Aggregate p95: 0.2363932301 seconds (required: less than 2 seconds).
- Family p95: create 0.0174934500; edit 0.0202936250; reorder 0.2455272800; state 0.0252756951 seconds.
- Test duration: 16.709 seconds; exit code 0.
